DTCs.name: Blower Motor Circuit Fault
DTCs.description: Detected malfunction in the blower motor electrical circuit.

DTCs.name: Blower Motor Resistor Failure
DTCs.description: Blower motor does not respond correctly to speed settings.

DTCs.name: Air Mix Door Actuator Malfunction
DTCs.description: HVAC cannot properly mix hot and cold air.

DTCs.name: Mode Door Actuator Fault
DTCs.description: Airflow direction cannot be switched between vents.

DTCs.name: Recirculation Door Actuator Fault
DTCs.description: Cannot switch between recirculated air and fresh air intake.

DTCs.name: Cabin Temperature Sensor Failure
DTCs.description: Cabin temperature reading is out of range or missing.

DTCs.name: Ambient Temperature Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Outside air temperature sensor not providing valid data.

DTCs.name: Evaporator Temperature Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Evaporator coil temperature is not detected properly, risk of freeze-up.

DTCs.name: HVAC Control Module Communication Error
DTCs.description: Control module is not responding to inputs or commands.

DTCs.name: Heater Core Flow Restriction
DTCs.description: Insufficient coolant flow through heater core detected.
